notes.title: A lot of bug fixes and a couple of changes
notes.notes:
Howdy, this update mainly fixes a lot of bugs but it also adds a couple of features and tweaks some balance to make things more realistic.

The species now need different heats and humidity than before to more closely match the actual species. There's also a new setting that let's you change the reflectiveness of glass because that bothered some people.

Changes:
[list]
[*] I'm not sure what is new and what is not, I should really keep track of this...
[/list]

notes.title: (Performance) improvements | Update
notes.notes:
Howdy, I've added a couple of things to improve performance in large colonies (they should also help smaller ones). I did this by not rendering some ants when many ants are close together. There's still some things I would like to add to improve performance but it should be much better now. This is effected by performance settings.

Also you can now fly up and down (Q and E), the liquid feeder is now slightly more intuitive and clear, and when betting you get more accurate feedback.

Hope you'll enjoy the game just like the 11 people who gave me a positive review! Thank you all so much for the support! I've sold almost 240 copies already, thank you all so much!

"C:\Users\YOUR PC USER NAME\AppData\LocalLow\Kunstaat\Ant Keeping Simulator" is the folder you want to look for If you don't want to restart if playing on a non-A save.
